fact: The National ICT Policy and Strategy 2019-2024, adopted by Cabinet, sets among its strategic goals for government agencies that 'all FGS and FMS local authorities have Internet access' by year 3 of the plan, after all federal and state ministries in Mogadishu by year 1, and lists local authorities among the rural public services whose connectivity is to be built in a co-ordinated way; it gives no count of local authorities, no baseline and no cost, saying costs are to be determined by each agency. The document carries no date beyond its 2019-2024 period, so the date here is its published year.
